title: European Master in Law and Economics (EMLE) 2027/2028
institution: European Master in Law and Economics (EMLE) consortium
about: Applications for the EMLE 2027/2028 Erasmus Mundus master in law and economics opened on 1 September 2026. Deadlines are 31 December 2026 for non-European applicants and 15 January 2027 for European applicants. About 15 full Erasmus+ scholarships are available per academic year.
requirements: Only fully completed applications including at least one letter of reference are considered
Scholarships are merit-based, ranked among complete, on-time applications
Targeted scholarships encouraged for applicants from Sub-Saharan Africa and the Western Balkans
